Unknown keys interleaved among interpreted ones, including a nested mapping (`location`) and a
list (`tags`). Preservation is the whole point of this fixture: none of `source`, `tags`,
`location`, or `priority` are keys this version interprets, none may be dropped on a write, and
each must come back as the exact bytes it was read as rather than as an emitter's idea of them.

Not in schema order, deliberately — a write moves the unknown keys below the interpreted ones.
